text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — APAC marketplace listing for NimbleEdge is asking for a notarized firmware-hash affidavit in addition to the SOC2 excerpt. They said 'local notarization or embassy apostille required' for the APAC regional catalog. cc @Owen Patel @Tess B :wave:
Owen Patel: Ack. Do we have precedent for notarized firmware hashes? I thought we did presigned artifacts + redacted SOCs only.
Lucas Romero: We usually do presigned S3 + an attestation doc signed by legal. This 'notarized' ask is new — probably country-specific e.g., SG/KR marketplaces. Need legal confirmation if a notarized signature is necessary or if a digitally signed affidavit is OK. @legal-sig can you weigh in? :eyes:
legal-sig: Quick read — some APAC marketplaces ask for a notarized affidavit for hardware vendors. For software-only listings they sometimes accept a notarized statement stating the firmware hash was produced by the vendor and hasn't been altered. Digital signatures are accepted if backed by a CA and accompanied by identity proof. We need two things: 1) firmware hash artifact (sha256) + 2) a notarized/attested affidavit PDF.
Tess B: OK — logistics Q: do we produce the affidavit or ask the SI partner (NimbleEdge) to provide? Also, how to fit in our redaction policy for SOC2 excerpts?
Maya Chen: NimbleEdge expects Redwood to bundle the firmware hash snapshot and affidavit because firmware is our runtime agent on the device. They offered to have their legal witness present but want Redwood's notarized piece.
Owen Patel: Next — artifact packaging. We should avoid putting full SOC2 report in the bundle. We'll include a 1-page SOC2 excerpt + signed attestation. Use presigned links with limited TTL. Artifact-bot, can you pre-create a presign set with near-term expiry and upload instructions?
artifact-bot: Created presign manifest: 3 URLs -> firmware.bin.sha256.txt (7d), affidavit-redacted.pdf (30d), soc2-excerpt-redacted.pdf (30d). Manifest ID: presign-APAC-1749993333.
Lucas Romero: Perfect. For the firmware hash generation, ops should run on the release artifact using this command and paste the output in the affidavit:
```
sha256sum firmware.bin > firmware.bin.sha256.txt
cat firmware.bin.sha256.txt
```
Maya Chen: Ops, please run that on the v1.2.8 release candidate and upload to the presign manifest. Also export the signing chain so legal can verify.
Owen Patel: Ops assigned: @Lucas Romero to run hash and @Tess B to coordinate upload + redaction checklist for SOC excerpt. Timeline: need inbound package to NimbleEdge by 2 business days (APAC deadline).
Lucas Romero: I ran the hash locally — sha256: 3b2f9d7a... (truncated here). I'll upload full file to presign-APAC and attach checksum.
Tess B: Working on SOC redaction. Will remove employee PII and operational notes, leave relevant control narrative for 'change management' and 'deployment pipeline' sections. I'll put the redaction checklist in the manifest as redaction-checklist.md.
legal-sig: Drafting affidavit template now. We'll include the firmware hash value, generation command, timestamp, and signatory block. For notarization we can use our local Notary Service (approved vendor). That process takes ~1 business day and requires in-person signature or e-notary verifiable by OIDC. Recommend e-notary workflow to meet deadline.
Maya Chen: Great — set e-notary. Owen will approve final affidavit content before notarization.
Owen Patel: I'm available to review before noon tomorrow PT. Also confirm destination compliance: NimbleEdge wants an apostille for SG listing — legal, can your team advise if e-notary + apostille is possible?
legal-sig: E-notary + apostille is tricky; some countries require an in-country notary. If NimbleEdge insists on apostille, they should process locally (they're a local SI). Suggest we provide notarized affidavit (e-notary) + a signed letter saying SI can obtain an apostille if required. That should unblock listing.
Maya Chen: Sounds good. Final action items:
- Lucas Romero: generate firmware sha256, upload to presign-APAC-1749993333 (due in 6h)
- Tess B: redacted SOC excerpt + redaction-checklist.md, upload (due EOD)
- legal-sig: prepare affidavit draft and route for e-notary (due EOD)
- Owen Patel: review affidavit and sign-off once routed (due tomorrow noon PT)
NimbleEdge contact (FYI): once we upload, we'll share presigned manifest and a short README with redaction notes and instructions for apostille if they need it.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. If anything blocks, post here. :thumbsup:
